parameters.name: KeepAliveSent
parameters.description: The total number of KeepAlive {{units}} sent out the tunnel.

parameters.name: KeepAliveReceived
parameters.description: The total number of KeepAlive {{units}} received by the tunnel.

parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} sent by the tunnel.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} received by the tunnel.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} sent by the tunnel.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} received by the tunnel.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} discarded by the tunnel due to any error. This can include packets dropped due to a lack of transmit buffers.

parameters.name: ErrorsReceived
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} received by the tunnel that contained errors preventing them from being delivered to a higher-layer protocol.

object.description: Statistics for this GRE tunnel, i.e. all traffic that has passed through the tunnel. The device MUST reset the tunnel's Stats parameters (unless otherwise stated in individual object or parameter descriptions) either when the tunnel becomes operationally down due to a previous administrative down (i.e., Status parameter transitions to a disabled state after the tunnel has been disabled) or when the tunnel becomes administratively up (i.e. the Enable parameter transitioned from {{false}} to {{true}}).
